OverviewKey FeaturesProduct DetailsSpecifications

Two-circuit smart lighting control

The ELVARO TS02-US-W2 is a 2-gang WiFi smart touch wall switch for modern residential and interior lighting applications. Its glass panel and capacitive touch control provide a simple way to switch two connected lighting circuits on or off.

Using a 2.4GHz WiFi connection and a compatible mobile app, users can control the two lighting circuits remotely and create lighting schedules to suit daily routines. Compatible Amazon Alexa and Google Home devices also support voice commands.

Two-location control can be configured where supported, subject to the selected setup and app configuration. Available in black and white finishes, the switch requires both live and neutral wiring. Share your lighting load and installation requirements with ELVARO to confirm the appropriate configuration.

Key Features

  • 2-gang control for two lighting circuits
  • Glass panel with capacitive touch operation
  • 2.4GHz WiFi and compatible app control
  • Voice control through compatible Alexa and Google Home devices
  • Scheduling for daily lighting routines
  • Black and white finish options
  • Live and neutral wiring required
